messages:
Priya (CTO): Quick follow-up thread from today’s all-hands about the reorg + hiring playbook. Please ask clarifying q's here so we can post a short FAQ later.
Marco (CEO): Appreciate the thoughtful questions during the meeting. This shuffle is about reducing handoffs and speeding product iteration.
Tasha (SWE): Will role descriptions change for the folks being moved into Runtime?
Anya (Dir, Runtime): We'll publish updated role bullets by EOD Thu. Most changes are responsibility clarifications, not new committees. If scope increases, we’ll discuss with affected folks first.
Ben (Eng Manager): For teams losing headcount, do we get temporary contractors to avoid delivery gaps?
Rene (People Ops): Short answer: yes, in exceptional cases. Managers should submit the quick gap request form (link in our handbook) and cc finance. We'll triage within 48h.
Tasha (SWE): What about equity/hiring bands for the new "Runtime Specialist" band mentioned?
Rene (People Ops): That band is an IC-focused lane; compensation bands will align with existing seniority tiers. No retroactive equity adjustments unless promoted.
Priya (CTO): Also adding: we will run a 2-week "transition window" where owners shadow each other to hand over runbooks and dashboards.
Ben (Eng Manager): Good. Who signs the final ownership doc?
Anya (Dir, Runtime): The receiving manager + product PM will sign off, with a copy to Priya. We’ll use the ownership template in Confluence.
Tasha (SWE): Is there an official communication we can forward to external vendors or customers about team changes?
Marco (CEO): Vendor messaging should be coordinated with bizops. Reach out to comms@redwood and we’ll provide a one-paragraph statement.
Recruiter Bot: New internal reqs posted: REQ-943 (Runtime Eng), REQ-944 (Infra SWE), REQ-945 (Dedicated Ops). Internal referral link: https://intra.redwood/refer.
Rene (People Ops): Internal transfers: you must have a manager signoff + 2-week notice. We’re waiving the 4-week cool-off for this wave to encourage mobility.
Tasha (SWE): Will there be a follow-up all-hands or Q&A specifically for people impacted by moves?
Priya (CTO): Yes 30 dedicated sync for affected teams Thu 3pm PT. Managers will run team-level drop-in 1:1s the following week.
Ben (Eng Manager): Oncalls: will SLO ownership change?
Anya (Dir, Runtime): SLO ownership stays with the owning product for external-facing SLOs; runtime will own the infra-facing SLOs (cache miss, latency tail) and we'll post a matrix mapping by next Tue.
Tasha (SWE): Equipment / access updates for moved folks?
Rene (People Ops): IT will get a CSV from managers with access changes; expect a max 48h turnaround. For hardware moves, file asset requests here: https://intra.redwood/it-assets.
Priya (CTO): If you think a role should move the other direction (Runtime -> Platform), put a short note in this thread and tag your manager. We will consider feedback during the transition week.
Ben (Eng Manager): Any changes to promotion timelines because of the reorg?
Rene (People Ops): Promotion cycles unaffected. If someone’s scope increases and they want an accelerated review, managers can submit a fast-track justification.
Tasha (SWE): Thanks. One last Q: Will interview loops for Runtime roles include new live-debug exercise?
Recruiter Bot: Interview update: Runtime loop will add a short systems-design + latency debugging exercise (30m). Updated recruiter packet on the wiki.
Priya (CTO): Thanks all. We'll compile a short FAQ and the ownership matrix by Friday and drop it here. If anything private, ping Rene or your manager.
Allhands Bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://intra.redwood/all-hands/1735550001/ (slides v2). :white_check_mark:
